question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The scientist's _______________ research into renewable energy sources is expected to revolutionize the industry.
solution:
The correct answer is '**meticulous**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**meticulous**" means showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise. (सूक्ष्म)
 
• The sentence refers to the scientist's detailed research work, which is expected to bring significant changes to the renewable energy industry.
 
• The other options: "**superficial**," "**hasty**," and "**cursory**" imply a lack of depth or care, which does not align with the context of revolutionary research.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The scientist's meticulous__ research into renewable energy sources is expected to revolutionize the industry.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Superficial (सतही)**: means existing on the surface; not thorough or deep.
 
• **Hasty (जल्दबाज़)**: means done with excessive speed or urgency; hurried.
 
• **Cursory (संक्षिप्त)**: means hasty and therefore not thorough or detailed.
